A.text: Each follow-up should include more than a clinical exam, namely radiographic exams, pulp sensibility testing, and symptom questioning, regardless of complaints.

B.text: Each post-trauma follow-up should include symptom questioning, clinical and radiographic exams, and pulp sensibility testing.
Monitoring matters because complications such as pulp necrosis and infection, pulp space obliteration, root resorption, and marginal gingiva and bone breakdown can develop.

C.text: Radiographic examination is part of each follow-up and is not limited to symptomatic patients.

D.text: Pulp sensibility testing belongs to each follow-up, not just the first visit.

explanation.text: Every post-trauma follow-up should combine symptom questioning, clinical and radiographic exams, and pulp sensibility testing.
This thorough review helps detect main post-traumatic complications such as pulp necrosis and infection, pulp space obliteration, root resorption, and marginal gingiva and bone breakdown.
